candidate_claims.claim_text: Across the 18 rows of analytics/candidate_telemetry.jsonl with run_date 2026-11-24 at repository pin 9571a9a6c6bc4e6f02408b222d9be78e00818d6d, the set of rows with a non-zero $.verdict_v2.rings.ip_as_investment.lexical_subtotal (3 rows: 13, 12, 9) and the set of rows whose $.verdict_v2.nexus is 'established' or 'asserted' (4 rows: three pca_press notices at 'established' and one iareporter_headlines tribunal-constitution notice at 'asserted') are disjoint, with an intersection of 0; the single row whose ip_as_investment strength is 'present' on a body the instrument read carries nexus 'absent'.
candidate_claims.supporting_locator: analytics/candidate_telemetry.jsonl, rows with run_date == '2026-11-24', fields $.verdict_v2.nexus and $.verdict_v2.rings.ip_as_investment.lexical_subtotal; rows matched to locators in state/seen.json by sha256_hex(url) per src/telemetry.py:183; run in session with python3 -I. LIMITS, binding, AS AMENDED IN THE VETTING ROUND OF 2026-11-25: (1) this is ONE run of 18 rows. CORRECTED DENOMINATOR (objection 1125-C2, conceded): the all-time telemetry corpus at this pin holds 589 rows, 578 of them carrying $.verdict_v2.rings (11 at mode 'off'), over 506 distinct (run_date, candidate_id) pairs -- so every all-time rate is a rate over ROWS and not over candidates, with 72 excess rows. The figure '488 rows' carried in the first filing of this claim is WITHDRAWN: it was correct at STATE_OF_THE_ANSWER.md:651 for the pin that caveat was written at, and is stale here. (2) it is NOT a defect claim -- every value is correct by the field's own definitions at prompts/classifier_v2.txt:162-174, where 'established' requires an identified proceeding and 'absent' may be returned only from a read body; (3) the strong-nexus side of THIS RUN has n=4, three of them one source on one day, and no probability model is offered because the 18 are not a random draw; (4) THE ACCESS-REGIME EXPLANATION FILED WITH THIS CLAIM IS WITHDRAWN AS FALSIFIED (objection 1125-C1, conceded in full). The chairman screened the falsifier this seat named and did not run: over the 578 ring-carrying rows, 118 carry a strong nexus AND evidence_location 'accessible_body', across 8 hosts, and ALL 118 carry ip_as_investment.lexical_subtotal of exactly 0; all-time strong-nexus 147, all-time non-zero ip_as_investment 28, rows that are both 0; and iisd_itn appears on both lists (10 and 2), so one channel demonstrably produces both kinds of row. The sentence 'a zero in the overlap is not evidence of an empty overlap when no channel can populate both sides of it' is FALSE at corpus scale and may not be cited. (5) WHAT REPLACES IT: the disjointness GENERALISES (0 across 147 x 28 all-time) and is therefore stronger evidence than this seat allowed; the only limit that survives is G19's -- 77 of the 118 zeros have text_len_body at a cap value (72 at 4,000 and 5 at 5,000), and 66 of 118 are one host (www.italaw.com), so a zero there licenses 'this document's read prefix carries no asset vocabulary' and never 'no IP asset was pleaded in the underlying matter'. (6) 38 of the 118 carry lane 'RETRY' / public_label 'Not yet classified', so on completed classifications alone the falsifier is 80 of 578 rather than 118 -- which refutes the withdrawn limb just as completely. (7) THIS CLAIM IS NOW A STRICTLY WEAKER INSTANCE of the chairman's corpus-scale measurement and this seat recommends HIS figures be banked in preference to it.

candidate_claims.claim_text: At repository pin 9571a9a6c6bc4e6f02408b222d9be78e00818d6d the committed relay corpus holds 126 files and 864 records; 487 of those records are on icsid.worldbank.org (484 ok, 3 refused) and 154 distinct NON-EMPTY 'find' literals have been fired on that host, of which NONE contains the string 'Iraq'; corpus-wide exactly 1 of 203 distinct non-empty distinct find literals contains it. The path https://icsid.worldbank.org/cases/recent returns ok on 24 of 24 records and serves full case captions with ICSID designators into the searchable text, demonstrated by find_matched true on 'ARB/' and 'ICSID Case No.' with the in-corpus excerpt 'October 6, 2026 Lombard North Central PLC v. Republic of Turkiye (ICSID Case No. ARB/26/40)'. By contrast https://icsid.worldbank.org/cases/pending returns ok at about 74 KB while 'ARB/' returns find_matched false on two separate dates (2026-09-07 and 2026-10-10) and 'ICSID Case No.' returns find_matched false on 2026-10-10 only.

candidate_claims.supporting_locator: analytics/fetch-results/2026-10-10-daily.json, the record with url 'https://icsid.worldbank.org/cases/recent' and find 'ARB/', field $.records[].excerpt; census over analytics/fetch-results/*.json (126 files, 864 records) grouped by host, path and outcome, with the record array read from the key 'records' as the committed schema names it. LIMITS, binding: (1) the capability limb is NOT new -- analytics/insights.jsonl:158 (2026-09-09) already holds that /cases/recent serves respondent-State names into the searchable text, and this claim applies that finding rather than discovering it; (2) /cases/recent is a union of four recency feeds per insights.jsonl:263 and NO date on it may be read as a registration date; (3) the cases/pending measurement is a statement about the SERVED byte-stream and is expressly NOT a claim that the page is empty for a browser; (4) the 'never asked about Iraq' limb is a statement about this committed corpus at this pin and about nothing else. AMENDED IN THE VETTING ROUND OF 2026-11-25: (5) objection 1125-C3 CONCEDED -- the published figures 155 and 204 admitted the empty string (the find field of the example.com control row) as a distinct literal; on non-empty find values the counts are 154 on icsid.worldbank.org and 203 corpus-wide, and 173 records corpus-wide carry an empty or absent find. The substantive limb is untouched: no find literal on that host contains 'Iraq'. (6) objection 1125-C4 CONCEDED -- 'ICSID Case No.' was fired at /cases/pending on 2026-10-10 only, one date and not two; 'ARB/' is false on two dates; 'ICSID' matched true on five dates by this seat's count, where the chairman reported four, and that divergence is noted and not resolved. The recommendation against firing /cases/pending is unaffected.
